c2-rom-0024: Paul speaks of what Christ did for our offenses. Stay with Romans 4:25.
c2-jas-0009: James speaks of empty words without help. He also speaks of what even demons believe. Stay with James 2:16 and James 2:19.
c3-gen-0064: Abram speaks to the LORD. The word of the LORD also comes to him. Stay with Genesis 15:2 and Genesis 15:4.
c3-gal-0012: Paul asks the Galatians a hard question. He also asks how God works among them. Stay with Galatians 3:3 and Galatians 3:5.
c3-rom-0025: Paul speaks of Abraham and the promise. He also speaks of the law and wrath. Stay with Romans 4:21 and Romans 4:15.
c3-jas-0010: Scripture is quoted about Abraham. James also speaks of faith and works. Stay with James 2:23 and James 2:26.
c3-rom-0026: Paul quotes a blessing from the psalms. He also speaks of Abraham's hope. Stay with Romans 4:7 and Romans 4:18.
c3-gal-0013: Paul calls out to the Galatians. He also speaks of Abraham's sons. Stay with Galatians 3:1 and Galatians 3:7.
c3-rom-0027: Paul looks ahead from Abraham to us. He also asks whom the blessing is for. Stay with Romans 4:24 and Romans 4:9.
c3-jas-0011: James continues his teaching on faith and works. Stay with James 2:18 and James 2:24.
c2-jhn-0035: John tells of the Word entering the world. Stay with John 1:11.
c2-jhn-0036: John speaks of the Word. He also speaks of His fullness. Stay with John 1:14 and John 1:16.
c3-jhn-0037: Jesus speaks to the disciples. He also speaks of the Spirit of truth. Stay with John 14:25 and John 14:17.
c3-heb-0026: The letter opens with a word about God. Jesus also tells them of love and His commandments. Stay with Hebrews 1:1 and John 14:15.
c3-jhn-0038: No one has seen God. John also speaks of the Word in the world. Stay with John 1:18 and John 1:10.
c3-jhn-0039: John the Baptist bears witness. A disciple also asks Jesus a question. Stay with John 1:15 and John 14:22.
c3-jhn-0040: Jesus answers about love and His word. John also speaks of the beginning. Stay with John 14:23 and John 1:2.
c3-heb-0027: The Son is set above the angels. Jesus also comforts the disciples. Stay with Hebrews 1:4 and John 14:18.
c3-jhn-0041: Jesus speaks to the disciples. John also speaks of the witness to the Light. Stay with John 14:20 and John 1:8.
c3-jhn-0042: John speaks of those who received Him. Jesus also speaks of those who do not love Him. Stay with John 1:13 and John 14:24.
c2-jas-0012: James greets the readers of his letter. Stay with James 1:1.
c2-1pe-0011: Peter writes to the pilgrims and greets them with grace. Stay with First Peter 1:2 and First Peter 1:1.
c3-1jn-0009: John continues his letter. He also begins with what they have heard and seen. Stay with First John 2:3 and First John 1:1.
c3-1pe-0012: Peter closes his letter. Jude also greets the readers with mercy and peace. Stay with First Peter 5:12 and Jude 1:2.
c3-2pe-0005: Peter looks ahead for the readers. A greeting also comes from the church in another city. Stay with Second Peter 1:15 and First Peter 5:13.
c3-2pe-0006: Peter turns to Paul's letters. He also greets them with grace and peace. Stay with Second Peter 3:16 and Second Peter 1:2.
c3-1jn-0010: John writes as a witness. Peter also sends a closing greeting of peace. Stay with First John 1:3 and First Peter 5:14.
c3-2pe-0007: Peter speaks of our beloved brother Paul. He also speaks of the Lord's precious promises. Stay with Second Peter 3:15 and Second Peter 1:4.
c3-jud-0005: Jude gives a short charge. Peter also greets those who share the same precious faith. Stay with Jude 1:22 and Second Peter 1:1.
c3-jud-0006: Jude closes with praise. He also speaks of snatching some from danger. Stay with Jude 1:25 and Jude 1:23.
c2-mat-0039: John the Baptist warns those who came to him. Stay with Matthew 3:9.
c2-mrk-0024: Jesus defends the woman who anointed Him. Stay with Mark 14:8 and Mark 14:6.
c3-mat-0040: The temptation is over. Jesus also later moves to a town by the sea. Stay with Matthew 4:11 and Matthew 4:13.
c3-luk-0039: The road to the cross is underway. Two others later walk a road and do not recognize Him. Stay with Luke 23:26 and Luke 24:16.
c3-jhn-0043: Mary stands at the tomb. Two disciples also run there. Stay with John 20:13 and John 20:4.
c3-mrk-0025: Jesus is in the synagogue. The Spirit also sends Him into the wilderness. Stay with Mark 1:22 and Mark 1:12.
c3-mat-0041: John's clothing is described. Jesus also goes through Galilee teaching and healing. Stay with Matthew 3:4 and Matthew 4:23.
c3-luk-0040: Jesus speaks His last words from the cross. In the garden He also prays about the cup. Stay with Luke 23:46 and Luke 22:42.
c3-jhn-0044: John closes this part of his book. The disciples also leave the tomb and go home. Stay with John 20:31 and John 20:10.
c3-mrk-0026: The leaders make a plan. The whole city also gathers at the door. Stay with Mark 14:2 and Mark 1:33.
c2-rev-0023: The Lord speaks to John in the vision. Stay with Revelation 1:18.
c2-ezk-0017: Ezekiel is brought back to the river bank. A man also measures the water. Stay with Ezekiel 47:7 and Ezekiel 47:3.
c3-rev-0024: The Lord explains a mystery in the vision. Ezekiel also describes the living creatures. Stay with Revelation 1:20 and Ezekiel 1:6.
c3-dan-0019: The other beasts in the vision are not treated the same. Fishermen also stand by the river. Stay with Daniel 7:12 and Ezekiel 47:10.
c3-isa-0032: The LORD tells of a new heaven and earth. He also calls them to rejoice in His work. Stay with Isaiah 65:17 and Isaiah 65:18.
c3-rev-0025: John describes the servants of God. Ezekiel is also asked about the river. Stay with Revelation 22:4 and Ezekiel 47:6.
c3-ezk-0018: The living creatures are described. A voice also comes from above them. Stay with Ezekiel 1:11 and Ezekiel 1:25.
c3-ezk-0020: The living creatures are in motion. They also move without turning aside. Stay with Ezekiel 1:23 and Ezekiel 1:17.
c3-dan-0020: The beast in the vision is slain. Ezekiel also describes the expanse over the living creatures. Stay with Daniel 7:11 and Ezekiel 1:22.
c3-ezk-0019: Part of the river vision is set apart. The living creatures also move straight forward. Stay with Ezekiel 47:11 and Ezekiel 1:9.
c2-rev-0027: John falls down, and the messenger answers him. Stay with Revelation 22:9.
c2-rev-0028: John receives the vision. The song also speaks of those made kings and priests. Stay with Revelation 1:10 and Revelation 5:10.
c3-rev-0029: The Lord speaks of His coming. An angel also stands on the sea and on the land. Stay with Revelation 22:12 and Revelation 10:5.
c3-rev-0030: An angel gives a command. The great multitude is also before the throne. Stay with Revelation 7:3 and Revelation 7:15.
c3-rev-0031: The song asks who will not fear the Lord. Seven angels also come out of the temple. Stay with Revelation 15:4 and Revelation 15:6.
c3-rev-0032: John sees a great multitude. He is also told he must prophesy again. Stay with Revelation 7:9 and Revelation 10:11.
c3-rev-0033: John sees a shining sea in the vision. The angels also stand around the throne. Stay with Revelation 15:2 and Revelation 7:11.
c3-rev-0034: John hears a number. One of the living creatures also gives bowls to the seven angels. Stay with Revelation 7:4 and Revelation 15:7.
c3-rev-0035: John is asked about the white-robed multitude. A loud voice also praises the Lamb. Stay with Revelation 7:14 and Revelation 5:12.
c3-rev-0036: This book starts with a solemn word. They also sing the song of Moses and of the Lamb. Stay with Revelation 1:3 and Revelation 15:3.
c2-rev-0037: John continues this part of the vision. Stay with Revelation 12:6.
c2-rev-0038: The dragon is bound and sealed. The beast is also given a mouth and a set time. Stay with Revelation 20:3 and Revelation 13:5.
c3-rev-0039: A white horse appears in heaven. His appearance is also described. Stay with Revelation 19:11 and Revelation 19:12.
c3-rev-0040: The vision looks ahead for the faithful. They also overcame by the blood of the Lamb. Stay with Revelation 20:6 and Revelation 12:11.
c3-rev-0041: A great white throne appears. The rest of the dead are also spoken of. Stay with Revelation 20:11 and Revelation 20:5.
c3-rev-0042: A beast rises from the sea. The woman in the vision is also in labor. Stay with Revelation 13:1 and Revelation 12:2.
c3-rev-0043: A name is on the rider. The other beast also performs great signs. Stay with Revelation 19:16 and Revelation 13:13.
c3-rev-0044: The conflict goes on. The serpent has also been cast to the earth with his angels. Stay with Revelation 12:13 and Revelation 12:9.
c3-rev-0045: The dead stand before the throne. The beast and the kings also gather for war. Stay with Revelation 20:12 and Revelation 19:19.
c3-rev-0046: One of the beast's heads is described. The earth also helps the woman against the flood. Stay with Revelation 13:3 and Revelation 12:16.
